name: Tarumizu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tarumizu city emblem in navy: an outlined ring crossed by diagonal strokes, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Tarumizu, a city in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 1958.

features.role: Tarumizu city emblem — an outlined ring crossed by diagonal strokes, like a stylised character
